preconditions.description: The number of destinations n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of corridors m must be at least n - 1 and at most 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor must connect two distinct destinations within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e <= 10**9 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: The energy requirement e for each corridor must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m lines, one for each corridor.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= 10**9 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output value must be a valid energy requirement between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) == E_max[i] for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: Each output value must correspond to the calculated E_max for the respective corridor.
